newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH MOTOR PETROLEUM SALES TURN TO RISE IN AUG.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH MOTOR PETROLEUM SALES TURN TO RISE IN AUG.

text.p: Sales in Finland of motor petroleum turned into a rise in August, the Finnish Petroleum Association said in a monthly report received on Friday.
Motor petroleum sales increased 0.9 percent year-on-year to 0.17 million tonnes, it said.

"The sunny and warm weather which tempted people to drive by car to summer cottages and other leisure time travel can be regarded as a distinct reason for the increase in the use of motor petroleum," the association said.
In the 12-month period to end-August, motor petroleum sales fell 1.3 percent year-on-year to 1.87 million tonnes.
Sales of diesel oil -- mainly for the purpose of commercial transports -- rose 2.0 percent in August and the running 12-month increase was 0.8 percent to 1.48 million tonnes.

Total Finnish oil product consumption rose 3.7 percent year-on-year to 0.89 million tonnes in August, the January-August rise was 5.1 percent to 6.60 million tonnes and in the 12-month period to end-August, consumption rose 3.0 percent to 10.18 million tonnes, the association said.
